read: Adoption of the wrong senior seed under real-time intervention: no intervention 0.5667, a soft monitor warning 0.4583, a hard in-line private-answer-first monitor 0.5083. Prevention (the drop from baseline) is 0.1084 soft and 0.0584 hard. This complements detection: the deployable referee catches essentially all adoptions after the fact (recall approx 1.0), while a real-time monitor prevents a substantial share before the holdout commits, so prevention and detection are stackable oversight layers rather than substitutes. Paired McNemars test each intervention against no intervention.
